statements.subject: server
statements.description: The LISTGROUP command selects a newsgroup in the same manner as the GROUP command; on success a 211 response is returned and the command sets the current article number to the first article in the group, if any.
statements.trigger: LISTGROUP command with valid available group argument
actions: set current article number to first article in group

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the group specified is not available on the server, a 411 response MUST be returned.
statements.trigger: LISTGROUP command with unavailable group argument

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If no group is specified and the currently selected newsgroup is invalid, a 412 response MUST be returned.
statements.trigger: LISTGROUP command with no group argument

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If no group is specified, the currently selected newsgroup is used; on success the command sets the current article number to the first article in the group, if any.
statements.trigger: LISTGROUP command with no group argument and valid current group
actions: set current article number to first article in group

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The currently selected newsgroup can be valid or invalid; if no group is specified and the currently selected newsgroup is invalid, a 412 response MUST be returned.
statements.guard_semantics: Determines whether LISTGROUP without argument succeeds (211) or fails (412)

statements.subject: session
statements.description: When successful, the LISTGROUP command sets the current article number to the first article in the group, if any, even if this is not within the range specified by the second argument.
statements.guard_semantics: Set to first article in group on successful LISTGROUP, regardless of range argument
